اجلنفعوا (form IIIq)
# اِجْلَنْفَعُوا (ijlanfaʕū) /id͡ʒ.lan.fa.ʕuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِجْلَنْفَعَ (ijlanfaʕa)
# اِجْلَنْفِعُوا (ijlanfiʕū) /id͡ʒ.lan.fi.ʕuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِجْلَنْفَعَ (ijlanfaʕa)
